default_line: Anchor decisions on L2 URLs and excerpts in Details; if corroboration is watch, avoid roadmap promises until a second pillar agrees.

rules.line: Multi-pillar feature pressure: write a short internal L2 memo (what shipped vs claimed) before you commit roadmap dates.
Pricing and tiers on public pages drift—capture a dated screenshot for L2 and treat hero numbers as directional, not contract truth.
High priority while we are still Starting: name an owner and timebox discovery to one week; do not leave this in watch-only limbo.
Messaging-only with watch corroboration: refresh PMM talking points only after one product or changelog signal backs the story.
Confirmed positioning shift: update the competitive battlecard and align sales enablement within this sprint.
Support or success narrative: verify against implementation (docs, status pages, community) before we match tone in-app.
